name: shuoqi-wb-test-marketplace
description: Shuoqi's personal test marketplace for WorkBuddy. Hosts a handful of demo skills to validate the custom-marketplace end-to-end flow (add marketplace -> list plugins -> install -> invoke skill).

plugins.name: hello-world-skill
plugins.description: Minimal SKILL.md demo — proves the marketplace install + version-update pipeline end-to-end with zero external dependencies.
